title: The CEO needs gift cards between flights
scenario: A message from the CEO’s display name says they are boarding a flight and need 20 gift cards for client thank-yous within 30 minutes. They ask you to send the codes by text and promise to explain later.

answers.A: Buy the cards now but keep the codes until the CEO lands and confirms.
answers.B: Verify the request through a known executive assistant/CEO channel and follow procurement policy before purchasing anything.
answers.C: Ask for the request to be placed through the normal purchasing workflow, even if that means missing the deadline.

explanation: Executive urgency and secrecy are classic social-engineering levers. Holding the codes still creates unnecessary exposure and sunk-cost pressure.
proTip: Urgent executive requests still belong inside normal controls.
